rambling_dwarven_survivor.name: Rambling Dwarven Survivor
rambling_dwarven_survivor.description: A disheveled, wild-eyed dwarf in patched armor, muttering about monsters beneath the ground. He is wary but desperate for help—and may offer warnings, rumors, or even a crude map of the Marches if befriended.

archivist_automaton.name: Archivist Automaton
archivist_automaton.description: A semi-sapient dwarven automaton assigned to monitor and record the cell’s experiments. Scarred and flickering, it is conflicted—its primary programming to help, but secondary instructions to prevent any subject's escape.

damaged_security_overseer.name: Damaged Security Overseer
damaged_security_overseer.description: A dwarven construct, scorched and stuttering, still attempts to fulfill its original security protocols. It is confused and dangerous, lashing out at perceived threats but open to persuasion or reprogramming.
